newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan electronics fall as US hi-tech shares drop.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan electronics fall as US hi-tech shares drop.

text.p: Taiwan's star electronics sector, which have led the market's recent high-turnover rally, suffered a slight downturn at mid-morning on Thursday on the heels of U.S. high-tech stocks' overnight losses, borkers said.

U.S. blue chip stocks ended lower on Wednesday after two key computer firms -- Gateway 2000 and Seagate Technology -- warned of disappointing quarterly earnings, raising concern of possible trouble ahead for the technology sector.
After 70 mimutes, at 0210 GMT, Taiwan electronics were down 0.24 percent, while the overall index was up 0.33 percent.
Leading chipmaker Taiwan Semiconductor was down T$2.5 or 2.25 percent to T$108.5. Computer giant Acer had dropped 50 cents or 0.55 percent to T$90.
"U.S. high-tech shares' overnight losses did affect our electronics performance, but the effect will be short-lived," said independent analyst Michael Hung.
"Electronics, which have the best outlook among all Taiwan industries, will continue to be the bellwether shares for the market," he said.
In recent days, more than 60 percent of Taiwan trading has focused on the closely watched sector, brokers said.
